test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Jason was sent to school in England, where he __excelled__ academically and developed an interest in theatre and writing.
solution:
The correct answer is-** "Failed".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Failed" **is the most appropriate antonym of excelled.
 
• We use the word **"Excelled"** to mean - "to perform an action even better than usual or surpass an achievement".
 
 
• **Example: **Ram **excelled** his exams with a very good score.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options too.

 
• **Accomplished:** successful completion of a task or achievement of a goal.

 
 
• **Example:** One can **accomplish **anything in life by doing hard work.
 
 
 
• **Pursued: **to follow or chase someone or something, especially in order to acquire them.
 
 
• **Example**: He **pursued** his goals by studying hard the whole year.
